snippet.title: The Wake Event | Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
The terminal is online. ARGUS is watching. 

Watch the official announce trailer for The Wake Event, a narrative-driven sci-fi psychological horror puzzle game by Lickbeans Interactive. Utilize authentic cybersecurity concepts to unlock corrupted system modules inside an isolated deep-space facility—all while a silent, voyeuristic station AI monitors your commands, alters your environment, and rewrites the logs.

Exclusively on PC. Wishlist TODAY on Steam to support independent development! 

🔗 WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4757720/The_Wake_Event/

Follow the Dev Journey:
Website: https://lickbeansinteractive.com/games/the-wake-event
Steam Curator: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/39949978
